mapper.select: select uid, chat_no, region_id from `user` where chat_no = #{chatNo} limit 1 for update
select id from account_cute_no_record where uid = #{uid} and type = 0 and deleted = 0 limit 1 for update
select (select count(1) from `user` where chat_no = #{chatNo}) + (select count(1) from account where chat_no = #{chatNo})
mapper.update: update account set chat_no = #{chatNo} where uid = #{uid}
mapper.insert: insert into account_cute_no_record(uid, previous_no, cute_no, type, deleted, delete_by, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, expire_time, region_id) values(#{uid}, #{previousNo}, #{cuteNo}, 0, 0, 0, 0, now(), 0, now(), date_add(now(), interval #{dayNum} day), #{regionId})
